brief: DalFlore: modern science, delicate human care, white/black/green. Open Sans headings, Arial reading text. Compact sections and consistent 12px interface corners. Preserve original catalog labels, prices, checkout and Aline portrait.

references.observation: Photographic campaign hero, two explicit product paths, gentle motion, expert/brand tabs and expandable FAQ.
Art-directed product still life and strong product scale; clear section contrast.
Integrated product photography with quiet text area, prominent sales cards and informative product interactions.
Green photographic brand world, tangible materials, coherent product collection cards.
Emotional photographic opening, restrained composition and atmosphere tied to the subject.

layout: [campaign photograph + quiet left copy] -> [3 product cards / manual carousel] -> [science text + conceptual glass microbiota art] -> [forest connection diagram + pathway tabs] -> [Aline portrait + brand/expert tabs] -> [Duet-like FAQ].
critique: Earlier drafts relied on floating cutouts, orbit decorations, repeated uppercase labels and layered overrides. Replace the opening with one distinctive photographic campaign and build a fresh home stylesheet; retain compact information disclosure and actual commerce behavior. Do not borrow gold/pink palettes, serif fonts, testimonials, pharma areas, category filters or marquee bands.
